Meo Meo Cat Café, Vietnam – A Purr-fect Family Outing!

We recently visited Meo Meo Cat Café in Vietnam for the first time as a family, and it turned out to be a wonderful experience, especially for our 6-year-old! If you're looking for a calm, cozy, and joyful place to spend an afternoon, this café truly delivers.

From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with a warm, peaceful environment. The space is clean, nicely decorated, and designed to make both cats and visitors feel comfortable. It's not overly crowded, so kids have room to move around without feeling overwhelmed.

Cats Galore
There were a variety of adorable cats—fluffy playful tabbies, and some very curious kittens. Each one was well-groomed and clearly loved by the staff. Our child was overjoyed to gently pet and play with them. The cats were relaxed and friendly, and staff made sure visitors interacted respectfully.

This spot is perfect for young kids. They have low tables and seating, and the café is clean and safe. Our 6-year-old had so much fun—feeding the cats, watching them nap in hammocks, and giggling as they played with toys. It’s a great way to gently introduce kids to animals in a calm environment.

Drinks & Treats:
The café menu offers a nice variety of drinks. The iced milk tea and fruit smoothies were refreshing, and reasonably priced. There are light snacks too, but really, the cats are the main attraction here!

If you're in Vietnam and looking for a unique, relaxing experience with your family, Meo Meo Cat Café is a must-visit. Just outside the hustle and bustle of Ben Thanh markets. It’s clean, well-managed, and an absolute joy for animal lovers—especially little ones experiencing something like this for the first time.

We left with smiles, cute photos, and a very happy child who keeps asking when we can go back!
